package domain

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"sort"
	"strings"
)

// NormalizeComposeConfig treats omitted and JSON null configs as absent.
func NormalizeComposeConfig(raw []byte) []byte {
	trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(raw)
	if len(trimmed) == 0 || bytes.Equal(trimmed, []byte("null")) {
		return nil
	}
	return raw
}

// HasComposeConfig reports whether raw contains a non-null compose config.
func HasComposeConfig(raw []byte) bool {
	return len(NormalizeComposeConfig(raw)) > 0
}

type composeServiceMeta struct {
	Name  string
	Image string
}

// DeriveComposeConfigMeta returns title and description derived from compose config.
func DeriveComposeConfigMeta(raw []byte) (string, string) {
	services := extractComposeServices(raw)
	title := deriveComposeTitle(services)
	description := deriveComposeDescription(services)
	return title, description
}

func extractComposeServices(raw []byte) []composeServiceMeta {
	if len(raw) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	var payload map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &payload); err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	servicesRaw, ok := payload["services"].(map[string]any)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	services := make([]composeServiceMeta, 0, len(servicesRaw))
	for name, value := range servicesRaw {
		image := ""
		if service, ok := value.(map[string]any); ok {
			if rawImage, ok := service["image"].(string); ok {
				image = rawImage
			}
		}
		services = append(services, composeServiceMeta{Name: name, Image: image})
	}
	sort.Slice(services, func(i, j int) bool { return services[i].Name < services[j].Name })
	return services
}

func deriveComposeTitle(services []composeServiceMeta) string {
	if len(services) == 0 {
		return "custom"
	}
	lowerImages := make([]string, 0, len(services))
	for _, svc := range services {
		if svc.Image != "" {
			lowerImages = append(lowerImages, strings.ToLower(svc.Image))
		}
	}
	matchTitle := func(prefix string) bool {
		for _, image := range lowerImages {
			if strings.HasPrefix(image, prefix) {
				return true
			}
		}
		return false
	}
	switch {
	case matchTitle("nginx"):
		return "nginx"
	case matchTitle("alpine"):
		return "alpine"
	case matchTitle("node"):
		return "node"
	case matchTitle("php"):
		return "php"
	case matchTitle("python"):
		return "python"
	case matchTitle("postgres"):
		return "postgres"
	case matchTitle("mysql"):
		return "mysql"
	case matchTitle("redis"):
		return "redis"
	case matchTitle("mongo"):
		return "mongo"
	}
	if services[0].Image != "" {
		image := services[0].Image
		if idx := strings.Index(image, ":"); idx > 0 {
			image = image[:idx]
		}
		return image
	}
	if services[0].Name != "" {
		return services[0].Name
	}
	return "custom"
}

func deriveComposeDescription(services []composeServiceMeta) string {
	if len(services) == 0 {
		return "custom compose config"
	}
	parts := make([]string, 0, len(services))
	for _, svc := range services {
		if svc.Name == "" && svc.Image == "" {
			continue
		}
		if svc.Name != "" && svc.Image != "" {
			parts = append(parts, svc.Name+" ("+svc.Image+")")
			continue
		}
		if svc.Name != "" {
			parts = append(parts, svc.Name)
			continue
		}
		parts = append(parts, svc.Image)
	}
	if len(parts) == 0 {
		return "custom compose config"
	}
	return "services: " + strings.Join(parts, ", ")
}
